Clear written communication and the ability to explain inspection reasoning and classification decisions in a structured way are essential.

No prior AI or technical background is required. Training and project guidelines will be provided. What matters most is your familiarity with PCI surveys, attention to visual detail, and ability to consistently apply pavement distress definitions and rating criteria.

We are the premier sustainability partner for businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurant chains, assisted living facilities, retail franchises, and more. We have an opportunity for a motivated individual to fill the role of Contractor Onboarding Specialist. In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing our referred contractor pipeline and assisting in the training and onboarding of approved contractors.

Budderfly ’s continued success is directly related to the strength and quality of our national contractor network. As part of our continued commitment to customer satisfaction, Budderfly encourages customers to recommend their preferred contractors for inclusion in our network. The Contractor Onboarding Specialist role will focus on onboarding and training both customer-referred and nationally recognized contractors, actively growing our network of approved contractors while improving our customer satisfaction and time-to-install metrics. This role reports to the Senior Business Development Manager on the Contractor Relations Team.

• Contractor Pipeline Management: Manage Budderfly 's referred contractor pipeline, evaluating prospective contractors and determining whether they advance through the onboarding process based on established business, operational, legal, and compliance requirements.
